text:
cory: Quick q — planning a small change to chat/completions streaming payload: rename field `delta.type` -> `delta.kind` to align with other endpoints. Does that break any clients? We thought it's safe if we keep a compat alias, but should we instead add `kind` and keep `type` for a deprecation cycle? Need quick engineering decision.

anya: my 2c: avoid breaking existing parsing; add `kind` + leave `type` for now, mark deprecation in schema, and add server to emit both when enabled by feature flag.

sam: Echoing. Any perf/size concerns? doubling a small field increases token count for streaming.

cory: size ~ +6 bytes per delta on average in our samples. But we have some high-volume streams; cost could add up. Alternative: keep `type` and map to `kind` server-side for new clients?

jin: If runtime maps server-side, older clients unaffected. But new clients want `kind` for tools lib. Maybe don't change wire unless we can do header opt-in: Accept header `X-Redwood-Delta-Kind: 1` to toggle emission of `kind` (server emits both while opt-in).

anya: Love header approach. Canary via `chat-delta-kind` feature flag too.

sam: Implementation note: streaming code in runtime/streamer.rs will need a small hot path; I'll PR. Tests needed: 1) backward parser accepts `kind` or `type`, 2) streaming delta dedup when both present.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline result: staging build 2026-03-16T18:02 failed tests on streamer/serde.

cory: Sam — can you own PR and add test? I'll coordinate canary rollout. Target deploy this week?

sam: Yep I'll open PR today, assign to @cory for review. Quick patch sketch: 

```json
// server emits both by default behind flag
{"delta":{"type":"tool_call","kind":"tool_call","payload":{}}}
```

anya: Also add note to API changelog + migration doc. I'll draft.

cory: Cool. Action items: sam PR, anya doc, jin plan header + feature flag. If anyone objects speak now. :thumbsup: or :eyes:

jin: :thumbsup:

sam: PR up: 1750000105 - streamer-dual-delta. CI passing locally, pushing.

qa-bot: Automated regression harness queued — will post results.

cory: thanks everyone.
